title: CapacityObjectiveDetail
description: Per-call schema for organizational-capacity Round 2 (per-bucket elaboration). Called once per fixed bucket (people / technology / culture). The `id` (O.P/O.T/O.C) and `title` are NOT requested — assigned by assembly + provided as call input respectively. Capacity objectives have NO `category` field per the model. `linked_opportunity_indices` was added in Phase 1b of `redesign-analysis-visuals` so the AI annotates each capacity objective with the opportunities that would advance it.

linked_opportunity_indices.description: 0-based indices into the `opportunities` array shown in the prompt. List opportunities whose execution would directly advance THIS capacity bucket. Empty list when no opportunity in the list applies.
